title: Let Children Hear The Mighty Deeds
author: Isaac Watts (1674-1748)
credit: Isaac Watts, 1719.  Music: 'Lea' James Lea Summers, (1837-1881).
firstLine: Let children hear the mighty deeds
verses: Let children hear the mighty deeds
Which in our younger years we saw,
He bids us make His glories known,
His works of pow'r and grace;
And we'll convey His wonders down
Our lips shall tell them to our sons,
May teach them to their heirs.
Thus shall they learn in God alone
That they may ne'er forget His work
